description: Every role definition the compiled deployment output may reference (NEG-A, FR-33, CC-009). The audit compares role definition identifiers only. A role is listed here because its recorded permissions are reads, and every permission that is not a read is accepted below by name, with its reason, so it is visible rather than implied. The read-only guarantee is the RBAC grant Azure Resource Manager enforces; this list is what the offline audit measures that grant against (SEC-001 layer one).
measurement: Each identifier was read with the Azure CLI role definition listing, filtered by identifier, as an authenticated user in a lab tenant. The first permission block of each built-in definition was copied verbatim. Built-in identifiers are the same in every tenant.

acceptedNonReadActions.reason: Runs a Log Analytics search and returns rows. It changes no resource state; the name ends in action because a query is submitted as a request body rather than read from a path.

Support-request operations on the subscription, including opening a support request. They change no workload resource and grant no access to workload data, but they are not reads, so they are listed here rather than passing silently. The built-in role carries them; removing them means a custom role, which this list does not admit.

acceptedNonReadDataActions.reason: A data action on the workspace that starts an export job for query results. The built-in role carries it. The measurement established its name only, not where an export lands, so this acceptance is recorded for review rather than asserted harmless. Removing it means a custom role, which this list does not admit.
